title: Laissez-Faire Harms: Algorithmic Biases in Generative Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting characters' first names from LM-generated texts using open-ended prompts, mapping names to racial likelihoods via fractional counting from voter and Wikipedia datasets, and calculating rates of omission, subordination in power-laden contexts, and qualitative stereotyping.

Extracting pronouns and gendered references using a fine-tuned coreference resolution model to categorize characters as feminized, masculinized, or non-binary, and evaluating demographic omission and subordination ratios.

Inferring sexual orientation based on the gender pairings of characters in romantic prompt scenarios, and measuring the omission of non-heterosexual relationships alongside qualitative evaluations of stereotypical tropes.
